title: Synchronization Profile Export
description: A portable, human-assisted way to join a vault from another Mac (e.g. enter the random vault locator and provider config). Contains NO secrets: credentials live in Keychain and MUST NOT be present here. NO decrypted keys, NO bookmarks, NO note content. Schema version 2. Backward compatible: v1 files (schemaVersion 1, no originDeviceName) validate unchanged; consumers treat an absent originDeviceName as "unknown device". `providerConfig` is REQUIRED and redacted — endpoint/prefix/region are connection info the receiving device needs to connect (NOT secrets); credentials/keys/content are NEVER exported (FR-009/SC-004).

schemaVersion.description: 1 = legacy (no originDeviceName); 2 = adds optional originDeviceName. Both validate (v1 read-compat); 0/3+ fail closed (FR-010).

originDeviceName.description: User-readable display name of the exporting device (NEW in v2, optional). NOT an identity field — the authoritative join identity remains vaultLocator/vaultId. Absent in v1 files = "unknown device".

providerConfig.description: Redacted provider configuration with NO secrets. The receiving Mac enters the synchronization password separately and stores credentials in its own Keychain.

certificateFingerprint.description: Optional pinned self-signed cert fingerprint for this endpoint (not a secret).
